academic_boundary: The protocol wording and names are frozen before any new outcome. No molecular result or performance evidence is created by this artifact.

governance.basis: explicit repository-owner instruction; this is a governance authorization, not scientific outcome evidence
governance.directive: 独立Human Approvalを必須条件から外し、既存artifactを変更せず、repository ownerの明示的判断に基づくoutcome-blind protocol freezeを新規artifactとして作成する。V5 no-rebuildは実態に合わせてV5 fixed-source-whitelist / no-replenishmentへ改称する。その後、CIでfreezeを検証し、6つのmethod-native executorをoutcome-freeで実装・監査する。molecular candidate energy、H2/H4実行、90-item development queue、performance claimは一切許可しない。MB5終了後はMB6 queue freezeだけを許可して停止する。

semantics: record the exact source structure without candidate construction
do not create a child state
preserve the exact source generator structure
prepare a bound optimizer transaction but do not run it in outcome-free validation

structural-magnitude-pruning.authorization_boundary: the freeze authorizes MB5 outcome-free structural executor implementation and audit only; it does not authorize a molecule, Hamiltonian kernel, candidate energy, H2/H4 execution, development-queue execution, or performance claim
structural-magnitude-pruning.constraint_transformation: construct the registered single-coordinate deletion constraint for theta_i -> 0; reject the candidate if this transformation is not valid in the target family
structural-magnitude-pruning.deletion_unit: exactly one ansatz generator and its single variational coordinate
structural-magnitude-pruning.physical_deletion: remove the generator from the ansatz structure; setting its coefficient to zero is insufficient
structural-magnitude-pruning.reoptimization: use the request-bound optimizer from the committed pre-deletion state
resource_recount: rebuild the full circuit after deletion
structural-magnitude-pruning.resource_zero_rule: if a containing CEO block remains and measured resources do not decrease, record zero resource reduction and never label it a successful circuit reduction
structural-magnitude-pruning.rollback: failed optimization or acceptance restores ansatz structure, parameters, optimizer state, resources, and ledger transaction before terminating the attempt
structural-magnitude-pruning.score: squared residual of that registered deletion constraint; for an ordinary direct single-coordinate constraint, verify numerically and symbolically that it equals theta_i^2
structural-magnitude-pruning.selection: lowest score first; ties break by lowercase canonical structural candidate ID
structural-magnitude-pruning.sequentiality: after each committed deletion, rebuild and reoptimize the remaining ansatz, then recompute all surviving scores before selecting again
stopping: no structurally valid single-coordinate deletion remains
the next deletion is rejected by the frozen acceptance policy
the next required operation would exceed the componentwise work cap
structural-magnitude-pruning.target_family: only a valid single coordinate belonging to the pinned CEO/operator family of the source ansatz; blocks, subsets, and rewrites are excluded
structural-magnitude-pruning.work_cap: charge generation, constraint/score work, optimization, and full recount; reject the next operation before execution when any component would exceed cap

v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.authorization_boundary: the freeze authorizes MB5 outcome-free structural executor implementation and audit only; it does not authorize a molecule, Hamiltonian kernel, candidate energy, H2/H4 execution, development-queue execution, or performance claim
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.canonical_order: ascending equivalence_class_id, then ascending structural candidate ID
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.eligible_candidate_generation: run the pinned parent V4.1 structural catalog/screening rules using source structure, registered rewrite validity, and structural compatibility only
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.equivalence_classes: use the pinned catalog's canonical structural equivalence_class_id; no outcome-derived regrouping or historical rank is permitted
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.historical_rule: historical sentinels are provenance only and are never copied
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.overflow_rule: if more than four equivalence classes are eligible, select the first four under canonical order
pre_outcome_freeze: executor identity and pinned provenance commits
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.predictor_policy: no predictor is used for selection in v2; any future OBS-predictor variant must be a separate protocol and charge all measurement/computation work
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.representative_selection: within each nonempty equivalence class choose the candidate with the lowest lowercase canonical structural candidate ID
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.scope: selection semantics only; no H2/H4 queue is created and no H2/H4 execution is authorized
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.sentinel_count: one representative per selected equivalence class, with at most four sentinels per case
v4.1-one-shot-joint-compression.source_checkpoint: one pinned stationary source per H2/H4 case, with StatePreparationID, ProblemID, Hamiltonian digest, and source checkpoint digest frozen

v5-fixed-source-whitelist-no-replenishme.authorization_boundary: the freeze authorizes MB5 outcome-free structural executor implementation and audit only; it does not authorize a molecule, Hamiltonian kernel, candidate energy, H2/H4 execution, development-queue execution, or performance claim
v5-fixed-source-whitelist-no-replenishme.causal_variable: structural candidate replenishment after accepted children
child_round: construct the normal full-V5 catalog for the current child runtime
retain every surviving candidate whose structural ID is in the source whitelist
bar every structural candidate absent from the source whitelist
recompute numerical constraints, predictions, curvature coordinates, and resources
apply the same current-state selection and ranking rule as full V5
v5-fixed-source-whitelist-no-replenishme.forbidden_compound_ablation: freezing source order would be a separately named frozen-catalog-order compound ablation and is excluded from this primary comparison
v5-fixed-source-whitelist-no-replenishme.ordering_rule: rerank surviving whitelisted candidates from current-child numerical values; source ordering is not frozen

renaming.reason: the executor rebuilds a current-runtime catalog and current-state ranking but forbids structural candidates outside the source whitelist; only replenishment is disabled

v5-fixed-source-whitelist-no-replenishme.stale_rule: a whitelisted candidate absent or semantically incompatible in the current catalog is recorded as STALE_UNAVAILABLE and is never executed

semantics: construct the current-runtime structural catalog after every accepted child
apply current-state ranking with deterministic candidate-ID tie-breaks

systems_boundary: Only MB5 outcome-free executor implementation is opened. All queue and molecular execution paths remain fail-closed.
